items.source: Note: This implementation does not support setLocale(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Locale) since the Accept-Language header can only be changed by changing the client's locale settings.
items.translation: 注意：此实现不支持setLocale(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Locale)，因为Accept-Language标头只能通过更改客户端的区域设置来修改。

items.source: If there is no match, then the defaultLocale is used, if configured, or otherwise falling back on ServletRequest.getLocale().
items.translation: 如果没有匹配项，则使用配置的`defaultLocale`，否则回退到`ServletRequest.getLocale()`。

items.source: Get the configured list of supported locales.
items.translation: 获取配置的受支持区域列表。

items.source: Set the current locale to the given one.
items.translation: 将当前区域设置设置为指定的区域。

items.source: For example, if the supported locales are ["de-DE","en-US"], then a request for "en-GB" will not match, and neither will a request for "en". If you want to support additional locales for a given language such as "en", then you must add it to the list of supported locales.
items.translation: 例如，如果支持的区域设置是 `["de-DE","en-US"]`，那么对 `"en-GB" 的请求将不匹配，对 `"en" 的请求也不匹配。如果您想为某个语言（如 `"en"）支持额外的区域设置，则必须将其添加到支持的区域设置列表中。

items.source: See setSupportedLocales(List) for further details on how supported and requested locales are matched.
items.translation: 有关支持区域和请求区域如何匹配，请参见setSupportedLocales(List)。

items.source:
In order for a supported locale to be considered a match, it must match
on both country and language. If you want to support a language-only match
as a fallback, you must configure the language explicitly as a supported
locale.
items.translation: 为了使受支持的区域设置被视为匹配，它必须在国家和语言两方面都匹配。如果您希望将仅支持语言的匹配作为回退方案，必须显式配置该语言为受支持的区域设置。

items.source: Can return a default locale as fallback in any case.
items.translation: 在任何情况下都可以返回默认区域设置作为后备。

items.source: Configure the list of supported locales to compare and match against requested locales.
items.translation: 配置要比较和匹配 requested locales 的支持区域列表。

items.source: Resolve the current locale via the given request.
items.translation: 通过给定的请求解析当前区域设置。

items.source: locale - the new locale, or null to clear the locale
items.translation: locale - 新的区域设置，或为 null 以清除区域设置

items.source: request - the request to resolve the locale for
items.translation: request - 用于解析区域设置的请求
当前区域设置（永远不为null）

items.source: request - the request to be used for locale modification
items.translation: request - 用于修改区域设置的请求

items.source: response - the response to be used for locale modification
items.translation: response - 用于区域设置修改的响应
